about.text: ×COUNTERPOINT · No. 001Playing CounterpointEach marble strike plays a note when sound is on.Press Sound to enable audio. If the wheel is paused, press Play.Drag empty space to rotate the view. Pinch or scroll to zoom.Turn the brass wheel backward to rewind. Release it to pause, or turn it forward to resume.Tap a porcelain plate to turn its note on or off. Moving marbles finish their routes.Keyboard: focus the sculpture and use arrow keys to rotate, + / − to zoom, and Home to reset. Use the time control to rewind and Notes to change the arrangement.View source code ↗
